title: 先生と学生の授業場面
subject: 先生と学生の授業場面
subject_en: A Japanese male teacher in his 40s with short black hair and glasses, green cardigan, and two middle-school students in simple navy uniforms, crayon educational worksheet style with soft uneven strokes, friendly expressions, no real person or existing character. Always the same face, hairstyle and outfit.
lead: 授業や学校生活の場面を、クレヨン風の親しみやすい線でまとめた素材です。学校プリント、学習記事、教育サービス、教室案内に向きます。検索結果でも用途が伝わりやすいです。
